name: dev.workers.rugsight.rugsight/rugsight
title: Rugsight
description: Solana token rug-risk scores. Free basic score; full report pay-per-call via x402 (0.03 USDC).

tools.name: get_token_risk_score
tools.description: Free basic risk score for a Solana token: 0-100 score, A-F grade (or IC for allowlisted issuer-controlled assets), verdict, risk flag codes, and whether on-chain metadata is mutable (informational; not scored). Free, no payment needed.

tools.name: get_token_risk_report
tools.description: Rugsight full risk report for a Solana SPL / Token-2022 token: mint & freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, top-20 holder breakdown (wallets vs pools/programs/burn), liquidity, main-pool LP burn/lock status (burnedPct, lockedPct, unlockAt), 24h volume, pool age, a launch-bundle / sniper heuristic for tokens up to 7 days old (very busy tokens may return status unknown), every risk flag explained, 0-100 score and A-F grade (or IC = issuer-controlled for allowlisted regulated assets such as USDC, PYUSD, cbBTC or xStocks), and whether on-chain metadata is mutable (informational; not scored). Costs 0.03 USDC on Solana per call, paid with x402: call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object, then retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: scan_wallet
tools.description: Read-only Solana wallet scan: every SPL / Token-2022 token held with its Rugsight grade and flags (top 20 by USD value), active delegate approvals, empty token accounts with reclaimable rent, and possible address-poisoning lookalikes from recent transactions. Automated technical data, not financial advice. Returns the free summary (counts, grade distribution, top 5 graded tokens); limited to 3 calls per day per IP. The full per-token JSON is GET /api/wallet-scan/<address>?full=1 for 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: explain_tx
tools.description: Plain-language explanation of a Solana transaction from one getTransaction read: status, fee, parsed actions (SOL and SPL/Token-2022 transfers, approvals, revokes, account creation and closures), best-effort swap descriptions for Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Meteora and pump.fun, and Rugsight grades for tokens the transaction touched. Unknown programs are labelled unknown. Automated technical data, not financial advice, not a safety guarantee. The free summary (status, fee, short explanation, programs, movements, up to 3 mint grades) is limited to 10 calls per day per IP. Pass full=true for the full JSON at 0.005 USDC via x402: call once to receive the PaymentRequired object, then retry with _meta["x402/payment"]. Use when you have a Solana transaction signature and need a plain-language explanation of what it did, including Rugsight grades for tokens it touched.

full.description: If true, return the full paid explanation via x402 (0.005 USDC). The free summary is returned when this is omitted or false.

tools.name: preview_receive
tools.description: Deterministic preview of a Solana Token-2022 transfer: the current on-chain transfer fee (basis points and maximum), the net amount the recipient receives, and flags for a transfer hook, freeze authority, permanent delegate, default-frozen accounts or a pause authority. Models a transfer only, not a swap or DEX pool fee. Does not execute or audit a hook program. Automated technical data, not financial advice. The free summary (net amount, fee, up to 3 flags) is limited to 10 calls per day per IP. Pass full=true for the full JSON at 0.005 USDC via x402: call once to receive the PaymentRequired object, then retry with _meta["x402/payment"]. Use when you need the net amount a Token-2022 transfer will deliver after the current on-chain transfer fee.

amount.description: Amount to send, in UI token units (positive decimal)

full.description: If true, return the full paid preview via x402 (0.005 USDC). The free summary is returned when this is omitted or false.

tools.name: decode_solana_error
tools.description: Decode a Solana custom program error or JSON-RPC server error from a hex code (0x1771), decimal code (6001), a line such as 'custom program error: 0x1771', a JSON-RPC code such as -32002, or a full program log. Returns every known program that defines that code, or a single exact match when a program id or slug is given, plus the Rugsight Solana Error Codes page URL. Free, no payment, no RPC, no API key. Same data as GET /api/errors/decode?q={error}&program={program_id}. Use when you have a failed transaction error, a program log, or a code and need the name, message and the /errors page for it.

error.description: Error text, log excerpt, hex (0x1771), decimal code (6001), 'custom program error: 0x1771', a JSON-RPC code such as -32002, or a full log line.

program_id.description: Optional Solana program id (base58) or Rugsight program slug (e.g. jupiter-v6) that raised the error. Narrows the match when the same code is used by more than one program.

tools.name: lookup_solana_instruction
tools.description: Look up a Solana program instruction from instruction data, an Anchor discriminator, a native instruction tag, or an instruction name. Returns matching programs, account lists, argument types and page URLs from a bundled IDL snapshot. No RPC. Programs can upgrade; computed Anchor discriminators are labelled as computed. Free, no payment needed. Use when you have instruction data or a discriminator and need to know which instruction it is.

data.description: Instruction data (hex or base58), a discriminator (e.g. 0xe517cb977ae3ad2a), or an instruction name (e.g. route or SetComputeUnitLimit).

program_id.description: Optional program ID, slug or name to narrow matches (e.g. jupiter-v6 or JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4).
